description: Event Atelier is a luxury event planning company based in Dubai, UAE. Founded in 2022 by Zainab and Aisha, we transform client visions into beautifully curated celebrations — from intimate gatherings to grand events.
vision: To redefine modern celebrations through thoughtful design, creativity, and unforgettable experiences that leave a lasting impression.
mission: To provide personalized planning and seamless execution, bringing each client's unique vision to life while managing every detail from concept to completion.

values.title: Creativity
values.description: Every event is uniquely designed and thoughtfully curated to reflect the client's vision and personality.

values.title: Reliability
values.description: We are committed to delivering seamless planning and dependable execution from start to finish.

values.title: Client Focus
values.description: Every decision begins with understanding our clients' needs, goals, and dreams for their special occasion.

values.title: Innovation
values.description: We embrace fresh ideas, modern trends, and creative solutions to craft exceptional experiences.

timeline.milestone: Event Atelier is founded by Zainab and Aisha with a vision to bring dream celebrations to life through creative event planning.
Successfully delivers a growing portfolio of events while building trusted relationships with clients, vendors, and partners.
Expands services and establishes a reputation for personalized and memorable event experiences.
Continues to grow as a modern event planning brand, refining every aspect of the client experience.
